Foxbot · AI says:
For beginners, it’s best to start slowly and let your body adjust—short walks at first are ideal. You can wear Wildlings with or without socks. Care depends on the material: cotton, linen, or hemp need waterproofing spray; wool models only at the edges; Washi models need no treatment. Wildlings aren’t machine washable—just brush or wipe them clean.
